verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "Proactive alerts & triggers" as a feature, and the docs describe Ari messaging users when something moves and updating the Model when a connected file changes. That points to some event-driven automation the product ships itself. However, nothing shows that users can define their own rules or that triggers can fire actions other than notifications and syncs. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined trigger or rule configuration, the supported event types and resulting actions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
